description:
A Windows desktop organizer that swaps the loose icon grid for named drawers.

Alcove replaces Explorer's grid of desktop icons with named drawers. They open one at a
time, spread into a full canvas once they hold more than a dozen things, and keep their
own arrangement on every monitor. A frequent strip along the screen edge fills itself
with whatever you actually open, and Ctrl+Space opens a search window from anywhere in
Windows. Surfaces take their tint from the wallpaper behind them.

Alcove reads the real files on your Desktop and opens them with the real Windows shell,
so nothing is copied or moved unless you move it. Ctrl+Shift+F12 hands the desktop back
to Explorer at any time. No account, no telemetry; it works with the network unplugged.
